profile.headline: Software Engineer at NextGen Federal Systems

positions.title: Student GIS Technician
positions.description:
Collaborated with colleagues and customers to create detailed map products.
Created various thematic maps for faculty and staff of Austin Peay State University.
Geocoded home addresses for students in the county.
Collected GPS point and other essential field data for analysis and map creation.

positions.title: Geospatial Engineer
positions.description:
Extracted geographic data from satellite imagery, aerial photography and field reconnaissance.
Created and compiled geographic data into maps.
Assisted commanders in visualizing the battlefield through the use of maps and other geospatial mediums.
Created and maintained multiple geospatial databases.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer Science, with a minor in GIS
